normal_y_max.notes: Metric3D/OpenCV floor-like normals must have camera-y below this value.

abs_z_max.notes: Reject forward-facing normals when estimating gravity from floor pixels.

min_pixels.notes: Minimum filtered floor-normal pixels required before gravity estimation is trusted.

angular_variance_soft_limit_rad.notes: Variance above this value reduces gravity confidence.

full_confidence_pixels.notes: Filtered pixel count needed for full sample-count confidence.

gravity_consensus.policy: Fuse floor, roof/table and global Metric3D references in camera coordinates by weighted angular medoid. Preserve legitimate camera pitch/roll; reject reference outliers instead of forcibly leveling the point cloud.

min_floor_valid_points.notes: Floor support-context probe minimum, separated from generic support min_valid_points.

bbox_fallback_max_distance_to_wall_m.notes: Conservative inner processed bbox fallback when a semantic support has no SAM mask; distant foreground remains rejected.

geometry_fallback_enabled.notes: Infer an unlabeled wall-adjacent counter/cabinet height band only when no semantic furniture is associated with the current wall.

furniture_min_bottom_gap_m.notes: Fallback only. Table uses 0.20m; counter/cabinet/sideboard and generic geometry support use 0.25m.

furniture_never_below_floor_default.notes: Furniture context may raise the artwork for clearance, but must not make it lower than the trusted floor default.

unknown.notes: Unknown support remains provisional unless a trusted metric floor source is available. Provisional previews must not be presented as finalized installation height.

max_metric_rule_deviation_m.notes: Automatic geometry may choose a horizontal axis but must not move a finalized metric center height by more than this amount.

max_structural_forbidden_overlap_ratio.notes: Deprecated as a direct hard reject when structural_clearance_policy is enabled. Kept for debug/score penalty; hard gate is wall-local artwork-edge clearance > artwork_width/3.

hard_reject_wall_inside_ratio.notes: Primary P1 hard reject threshold. 0.85-0.97 is review risk; >=0.97 auto-pass. opening/recess is an explanation field when solid_wall_mask already excludes holes.

min_semantic_axis_safe_mask_coverage.notes: Drop the entire semantic axis set when coverage is lower; do not clip the VLM s-range. Geometry axes from safe connected components may still be used.

projection_size_gate_enabled.notes: Final policy: no minimum projected artwork width/height/area gate. Tiny artworks and distant safe placements must remain eligible.

hard_reject_artwork_edge_support_ratio.notes: Edge support below this is blocked; 0.50-auto pass threshold is review only.

hard_reject_artwork_corner_support_ratio.notes: Corner support below this is blocked; 0.50-auto pass threshold is review only.

projection_shape_gate.policy: Preserve width/height edge identity from the 3D quad. Hard-reject orientation flips and anisotropic distortion above 1.75x; a VLM cannot override numeric hard rejection. This is independent of projected pixel size.

sam.notes: VLM boxes remain source; SAM refines support/forbidden/existing-content polygons.

floor_normal_alignment_dot_threshold.notes: Before floor RANSAC/project-to-wall, keep semantic-floor pixels whose Metric3D normals align with the chosen gravity reference; prevents person/wall contamination from becoming the floor plane.

max_empty_rect_metric_seed_tolerance_m.notes: Seed-only tolerance for Metric3D percentile noise. Exact projected artwork footprint, edge/corner, structure and blocking-fixture gates remain authoritative and unchanged.

max_obstruction_aware_height_shift_m.notes: A max-empty-rectangle candidate may only raise a trusted metric placement by this amount to clear a counter/shelf; lowering is forbidden and the exact final footprint is still hard-gated.

max_unconstrained_depth_tilt_deg.notes: Above this tilt, unconstrained depth RANSAC is not accepted as a wall model and gravity-constrained RANSAC must succeed. Replaces the former abs(dot)=0.55 (~33 degree) pass threshold.

max_direct_depth_tilt_deg.notes: A hangable wall's projection vertical is gravity-locked. Depth planes beyond this tilt may still support distance/occlusion but cannot define artwork orientation directly.

normal_recovery_angle_deg.notes: Depth/direct-normal horizontal-heading disagreement above this active threshold requires a unique wall-interior structure-line quorum; otherwise projection fails closed.

hard_conflict_angle_deg.notes: Maximum wall-interior structure correction allowed after a unique three-evidence quorum. Larger corrections remain hard conflicts.

direct_normal_fail_closed_on_quality_fai.notes: With enough samples, unstable or non-vertical direct normals reject the wall as an unreliable material surface. Direct-normal yaw is never copied into projection geometry.

horizontal_structure_angle_threshold_deg.notes: Maximum calibrated angular disagreement between the depth-preserving basis_u and the horizontal structure vanishing direction before correction or fail-closed handling.

horizontal_structure_max_correction_deg.notes: A confident structure estimate may correct depth yaw only within this bounded angle. Larger conflicts fail closed.

horizontal_structure_min_wall_interior_f.notes: Every Hough segment must be supported by the authoritative wall mask for at least this fraction. Ceiling/cove/window-adjacent lines cannot vote.

horizontal_structure_min_inlier_wall_len.notes: At least this fraction of final RANSAC inlier length must lie inside the authoritative wall mask.

horizontal_structure_min_inlier_wall_lin.notes: At least this fraction of final inlier segments must independently satisfy the wall-interior requirement.

horizontal_structure_min_post_projection.notes: After enforcing gravity orthogonality, at least this fraction of the raw line-consensus cohort must remain inliers; the old 6.77-degree residual regression fails this gate.

normal_conflict_structure_support_margin.notes: During depth/direct-normal conflict arbitration, wall structure must support one heading by at least this angular margin over the other.

controlled_structural_quorum.notes: 2-of-3 controlled quorum fallback for normal_yaw_conflict when standard three-evidence quorum cannot form. Uses segmented depth planes, reliable direct normals, and enhanced structure direction. Direct normal alone cannot unlock.

segmented_depth_plane.notes: Local depth plane clustering uses the dense projected xyz image and exact authoritative wall mask after subtracting forbidden, foreground, support, existing-content and non-support masks. It never partitions a shuffled 3-D list by global coordinate ranges. Plane-normal yaws are 180-degree axes, so n and -n always belong to the same physical heading cluster.

hierarchical_depth_consensus.notes: V19 fail-closed recovery for a depth/direct-normal yaw conflict. Whole-wall depth and axial segmented depth must independently pass every gate and agree. Direct normals validate material stability only and never contribute their disputed yaw.

wall_plane_fit.notes: Depth RANSAC remains authoritative for distance and occlusion. Projection removes the depth normal's gravity component. Direct normals validate wall stability. Only authoritative wall-interior seams may validate or correct yaw; post-gravity residuals are recomputed before acceptance. Sensor conflict without a unique three-evidence quorum fails closed.

existing_art_height_anchor.notes: When the floor is fully occluded, an existing work on the same fitted wall may provide a direct metric center-height anchor. This never creates or relabels a floor estimate.

existing_content_overlap_policy.notes: Only flat removable wall visuals can count as effective wall support. Physical fixtures such as shelves/cabinets/storage are blocking_existing_content and hard-reject if overlapped.
existing_content_overlap_policy.blocking_content_policy: physical fixtures are hard placement blockers and must not be counted as wall support or included in cleanup masks

cleanup_policy.notes: When a selected candidate overlaps existing art or wall clutter on the target wall, generate a cleanup mask for that overlap before hard paste / Flux render; do not clean non-target walls.
cleanup_policy.protected_scope: all pixels outside current candidate wall mask
cleanup_policy.remove_mask_dilation_stack_note: remove_mask.png is exported after local morphological dilation by cleanup_policy.remove_mask_dilate_px (default 6px). scripts/run_bfl_hanging_flux_pipeline.py then passes --erase-dilate-pixels to BFL erase-v1 (default 10px), so the effective erase expansion is approximately the two values combined. This is intentional for hooks/signage/small wall clutter; reduce either value for large existing artworks if boundary intrusion is observed.

remove_mask_dilation_policy.intent: two-stage expansion: local mask stabilizes semantic-object coverage, BFL server dilation smooths erase boundary
remove_mask_dilation_policy.risk: large existing artworks may intrude into adjacent wall areas; lower local_export_dilate_px or --erase-dilate-pixels when debugging boundary bleed

structural_clearance_policy.hard_gate: artwork vertical edges must be farther than artwork_width / 3 from doors/windows/openings/other forbidden structural classes in wall-local horizontal coordinates
structural_clearance_policy.soft_gate: Opening/recess overlap is an explanation field when solid_wall_mask already excludes holes. Primary support decision uses the safe wall support gate. Geometry quality scores remain ranking/review signals.
structural_clearance_policy.review_stage: export hard_paste.png and send high-risk placements to VLM visual review before final render/commit
structural_clearance_policy.notes: Generate candidate axes at valid gaps between door/window/opening intervals; do not reject an entire wall just because coarse axes are close to a window.
structural_clearance_policy.per_wall_coverage_policy: Apply only after hard gates. A wall may return wall_has_no_safe_candidate=true instead of forcing an unsafe render.

foreground_occlusion_policy.cleanup_mask_definition: art_region_mask ∩ current_wall_mask ∩ foreground/person_mask when median distance to target wall plane > 15cm

flux_export.notes: Official BFL manifest is selected after hardpaste exit gate: max 2 candidates per wall and max 4 total final renders. Same-wall NMS uses center distance plus projected polygon IoU.

flux_render.notes: FLUX.2 Pro edit payload does not include a mask/edit-region field; bbox/polygon are prompt instructions and art_region_mask is post-render QA/debug only.

render_size_qa.fallback_product_semantics: Do not silently replace failed Flux render with hard-paste success. Return PARTIAL_HARDPASTE_REVIEW.

room_corner_floor_fit.floor_line_sampling: wall RANSAC inlier points projected along g_hat_cam; use p3 floor-side extent; never treat visible safe-mask bottom as a finalized metric floor

hardpaste_quality.policy: small artworks are allowed; hard-paste quality is improved with supersampling instead of projection-size rejection

candidate_ranking.notes: Ranks against full visible wall extent. No 2D empty-space search or empty-space bonus is applied; existing wall art can remain cleanup/erase scope.

candidate_diversity.notes: Suppress same-wall candidates that become visually duplicate after projection, even if their wall-local axis_s values differ.
